Tremor metrics (frequency + amplitude, with a task tag)

Source: R/movement-tremor.R
tremorMetrics.Rd

Combines tremorSpectrum() and tremorAmplitude() into a single tremor summary, tagged with the recording condition. The rest / postural / kinetic distinction is task-context metadata supplied by the caller (the segment recorded under that condition), not a separate algorithm.

Usage

tremorMetrics(
  signal,
  sampling_rate,
  condition = c("rest", "postural", "kinetic"),
  band = c(3, 12),
  ...
)

Arguments

signal

Numeric movement signal (one axis or magnitude).

sampling_rate

Sampling rate in Hz.

condition

Recording condition: "rest", "postural" or "kinetic".

band

Length-2 tremor band c(low, high) in Hz (default c(3, 12)).

...

Passed to tremorSpectrum().

Value

An S3 tremor_metrics list: dominant_freq_hz, band_power_abs, band_power_rel, rms_amplitude, half_power_bw_hz, harmonic_ratio, condition, band, sampling_rate.

See also

tremorSpectrum(), tremorAmplitude()

Examples

fs <- 100; t <- seq(0, 20, by = 1 / fs)
tremorMetrics(1.5 * sin(2 * pi * 6 * t), fs, condition = "postural")
#> Tremor metrics (postural, 3-12 Hz)
#>   dominant frequency : 5.86 Hz
#>   RMS amplitude      : 1.059
#>   in-band power      : 1.125 (100% of total)
#>   half-power bandwidth: 0.39 Hz | harmonic ratio: 0.000
